key_decisions.decision: Include each title element and preserve poet/scribe imagery.
Preserve difficult linked virtues and instructing hand.
Preserve consequential divine address and document alternative syntax.
Keep God/your God distinction and anointing comparison.
Supply scent naturally and note uncertain musical term.
Retain women’s distinct royal roles and prized gold.
Preserve the shift to the bride and the demanding instruction.
Keep hierarchy and physical beauty without modernizing the marriage.
Retain city personification and gifts seeking goodwill.
Read inward location spatially rather than as moral inner beauty.
Retain female attendants and return to male addressee.
Keep masculine address and dynastic succession.
